rule: This independently reviewed observation and assertion contract is canonical input. Catalog generation validates against it and never rewrites it.

domains.case: case identity, parameters and action trace
domains.text: normalized text content, lines and metrics
domains.interaction: hit, selection, view and gesture state
domains.outcome: return value, diagnostics and host seam outcome

/captures/<checkpoint>/<path>.materialization: immutable runner checkpoint emitted either by an action as/bindAs output allowed by that opcode's binding.capturePaths or by fixture.captureCheckpoints at its exact action index
/captures/<checkpoint>/<path>.validation: checkpoint ID, phase, action index and path must resolve before generation; optional checkpoint.expected keys have exact parity with paths and bind to /<domain>/<checkpoint>/<path> assertions; runtime absence, wrong type or value mismatch fails the case

/<semantic-domain>/<path>.validation: domain must be declared and path must resolve at execution

runtimeRule: Every assertion path and reference must resolve. Operator observedKinds are enforced by the contract runner; unresolved or wrong-typed observations fail rather than becoming volatile.
